d: Transguard Group was established in 2001 and has diversified significantly, we lead in the fields of Cash Services, Security Services, Manpower Services, Facilities Management & Aviation. Transguard Group is the UAE’s most trusted business support and outsourcing provider and has a large, dynamic and culturally diverse workforce with 80,000 employees!
We are currently recruiting for an Assistant Operations Manager - Transport to join our Logistics Services team at our Headquarters, located in DAFZA (Dubai Airport Free Zone).

Reporting to the operations manager, directly responsible for the daily operational management of the passenger transportation division with group transport, responsible for the region-wise operational KPIs to achieve the highest level of service and manages the overall cost of the area or zone assigned.

Plays a key role in the TG fleet management with ground-level reporting and compliance inspections directly managed by the operations team – works closely with the fleet and compliance team to ensure the highest level of compliance across the TG fleet.
Work with the business units to improve the overall service to internal customers whilst maintaining the desired level of performance to the end-user TG client.
Maintain the cost control and operational metrics to achieve the overall scorecard requirements for the respective areas.
Manage the area supervisors to deliver operational excellence in the respective area, deliver the zone-wise scorecard metrics and operational KPIs.
r: Accountable for the operational P&L, monitoring the annual spending against budget and reporting on variances.
Directly accountable to deliver the CPH across the operations within the budget.
Responsible for executing vehicle scheduling, route planning and managing transport for employees.
Implementing fleet and operational policies and procedures for the Transport operations team, enforcing and upholding TG compliance
Manage daily operations ensuring drivers’ daily schedules are planned and optimized for efficiencies.

Conduct continuous analysis of vehicles, driver and schedule patterns to consolidate, improve and maximize usage of vehicles and resource to reducing transportation cost recommend cost control measures.
Manage the transport suppliers by providing transport services, quotes for new routes and ad hoc requests.
Manage Transport Risk Register which identifies any issues and vehicle risks that are reported by Transguard staff.
Perform changes in working conditions and use of vehicles to increase efficiency of operations and operations teams.
Assess driver and staff performance, provide reports identifying their strength and areas needing development.
Train, appraise and motivate staff to ensure optimum performance and successful team management.
Lead the BU in the deployment of smart routing and scheduling using the GPS and TMS tools to their maximum benefit.
Degree in Logistics required (bachelor’s degree preferred).
Experience in large fleet transport operations; passenger transport is an advantage.
5 years’ experience as a minimum in transport-related vocation.

d: UMO is a stealth-mode FinTech venture aiming to evolve the way people experience money by building a unified, AI-powered, yet deeply human money platform across fiat, crypto, and investments – subject to regulatory approvals. The platform is being designed to break down traditional barriers to money across access, assets, and experience, enabling simpler, more adaptive ways for people to interact with financial services.

We are currently developing our MVP and navigating licensing requirements, with a multidisciplinary team of 100+ people representing 20+ nationalities. With our headquarters in the UAE, we are united behind a shared ambition and a relentless focus on serving our customers.

As a part of our team, you'll help us shape a platform that works for One — a business owner, an artist, a freelancer. In this role, you will run day-to-day compliance, AML/CFT and sanctions work for UMO in the UAE, reporting to the Chief Compliance Officer & MLRO. You will be close to the business and to our UAE regulators, including Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA) and the Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE), and help build a compliance function that works for a regulated, multi-asset money platform from the ground up. We provide the space for you to exercise real ownership, stripping away micromanagement so you can deeply understand the business and turn regulatory rules into practical controls.
q: Experience: 7+ years in financial services compliance, AML/CFT and sanctions, including at least 3 years at a UAE-licensed bank, fintech or virtual asset service provider.
UAE Regulatory Expertise: Based in the UAE, with hands-on experience working with CBUAE and/or VARA. Exposure to SCA, DFSA (DIFC) or FSRA (ADGM) is a plus.
Regulatory Knowledge: Working knowledge of the VARA rulebooks, UAE AML/CFT law, goAML, targeted financial sanctions, PDPL and FATCA/CRS.
Investigations: You take AML, fraud and sanctions cases to a clear, well-documented conclusion.
Product Knowledge: Exposure to digital banking, payments or fintech business models in the UAE, and an understanding of both conventional banking and virtual assets.
Education & Certification: A degree in Law, Finance, Criminology or a related field; CAMS certification (or working towards it).
AI-Native Mindset: Active use of AI tools such as Claude to speed up research, reviews and reporting.
Culture & Communication: Open communication, transparency, mutual team respect, and an ownership mindset.
Can get you a few bonus points

International Experience: Compliance experience outside the UAE, such as in Canada, Africa, South America, East Asia or the wider Middle East, and familiarity with regimes like FINTRAC, SFC/HKMA, Japan FSA, Central Bank of Brazil or FIC/FSCA.
Global Standards: Working knowledge of the FATF Recommendations and Wolfsberg principles.
Correspondent Banking: Experience with correspondent banking due diligence and international bank relationships.
Payments & Tokens: Experience with CBUAE stored value, retail payment or Payment Token Services regulation.
Additional Certifications: ICA diploma or ACAMS CCAS certification.
Dynamic Work Environment: Vibrant offices and strong local teams across Lisbon, Dubai, Kyiv, and Lviv — with openness to remote for the right fit.
Rest & Recovery: 24 days of annual leave, dedicated paid sick leave, and observance of Public Holidays to keep you at your best.
Recharge Week: After your first year with us, enjoy two consecutive 4-day work weeks annually — a built-in reset to help you sustain peak performance for the long run.
Full Setup: Top-of-the-line hardware and a home office stipend so you can do your best work anywhere.
Growth Ecosystem: A dedicated learning budget and a clear, accelerated path toward executive-level leadership within the UMO ecosystem.
Impact & Ownership: Your work directly shapes the product and company direction — not just executes it
r: Compliance Framework: Maintain and update compliance policies, procedures and the risk-control matrix; run second-line monitoring and testing; review new products and changes for compliance impact.
AML/CFT Operations: Apply KYC and EDD standards, review high-risk customers, investigate transaction-monitoring alerts, and prepare suspicious transaction reports in goAML for the MLRO.
Sanctions: Run and oversee screening against UAE targeted financial sanctions, UN, OFAC, EU and UK lists, handle potential matches, and advise the business on sanctions questions.

Regulatory Liaison & Reporting: Support VARA and CBUAE licensing and ongoing obligations, prepare regulatory returns (including FATCA/CRS), respond to regulator requests, and track examination findings and remediation to closure.
Virtual Asset Compliance: Apply FATF Travel Rule requirements and use blockchain analytics tools (Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM Labs) to assess wallet and transaction risk.
Training & Advice: Deliver AML and sanctions training to staff, and give clear, practical compliance advice to Product, Operations and Technology.
